title: Worked example
description: The fictional thesis after all six exercises, in a real GitHub Project and a real repository.
---

The worked example is the fictional thesis after all six exercises. It lives on GitHub, not on this site, because a plan is useful only where the work happens. Open it next to your own repository when you are unsure about a step. The [Solutions](../course/solutions.qmd) page lists what to compare for each exercise.

::: {.callout-note}
The thesis, the people, and the dates are fictional. The data are synthetic.
:::

| Part | Where | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The plan | [Showcase Project](https://github.com/users/maehr/projects/11) | Eight epics (E01–E08), 34 sub-issues, three milestones, the "blocked by" dependencies, and the fields Status, Priority, Start date, Target date, and Basis |
| The work | [Example repository](https://github.com/maehr/projm-example-thesis) | The Issues, the [milestones](https://github.com/maehr/projm-example-thesis/milestones?state=all) with their justifications, the pull requests of X4 and X5, the release `v0.1.0-demo`, the [data dictionary](https://github.com/maehr/projm-example-thesis/blob/main/documentation/data-dictionary.qmd), and the [decision record](https://github.com/maehr/projm-example-thesis/blob/main/project-management/decisions.md) |
| The rules | [Requirements register](requirements.qmd) | Which rules apply, where they come from, and which Issue covers them |
| The publication | [Publication note](publication.qmd) | What can be published, where, and what GitHub cannot guarantee |

## Three views of one plan

The Project shows the same Issues in three views. Each view answers a different question, so you switch views instead of keeping three lists. The screenshots show the Project on 12 October 2026. The live Project can differ.

| View | Question |
| --- | --- |
| [Backlog](https://github.com/users/maehr/projects/11/views/1) | What is there to do, and how important is it? |
| [Board](https://github.com/users/maehr/projects/11/views/2) | What is the state of each task now? |
| [Roadmap](https://github.com/users/maehr/projects/11/views/3) | When does each task happen, and what does it wait for? |

## The source of the plan

The plan exists once as versioned text: [`project-management/backlog.yml`](https://github.com/maehr/github-as-a-project-management-tool/blob/main/project-management/backlog.yml) in the course repository. A maintainer script creates the Issues, the milestones, and the Project from this file. Learners do not need the file.

## Maintenance rule

Update the documentation in the same pull request as the data or the plan that it describes.
